content.description: Monthly NFT comic stories about two mediocre guys in their fifties. On the first Thursday of each month we will launch an episode that will be available to collect as two limited editions: We are Boomers! is a pfp collection, created to enlarge the Ash & Tray fictional universe with new characters that will have key roles in future comics. It features a bunch of mediocre fifty-somethings who haven't been wised up by age. They were mediocre at their best and that hasn't changed over the years.
